name: The Harbinger is stopped

date.label: The Burning Crusade · quest sequence; exact date unknown

summary: A’dal identifies Harbinger Skyriss as a servant of the Old Gods and says he seeks to bring his masters’ vision of universal conquest to pass. The warning is A’dal’s account of the prisoner, not an omniscient report of every Old God’s plan. The quest sends the seeker to kill Skyriss before he can escape. On the return, A’dal says that countless thousands would have perished if the Harbinger had broken free, comparing the danger to Skeram. That spared future is his claim; the confirmed ending is narrower: Skyriss is slain, and the immediate breach is checked. The prison’s other captives and the wider purpose behind them remain unresolved.
